title: A project added by setup cannot be removed again
what: Give the project list one writer for both directions: `relay setup` records the entry through a path that commits it (as `relay queue add` lands a queue item), and a `relay forget <name>` (or `relay setup --undo <dir>`) removes it the same way. Docs/setup.md names both.
why: relay setup writes the new project into relay's own projects.toml in the main checkout and leaves it uncommitted; no relay command removes an entry, and relay's guard refuses `git restore` in the main checkout, so a trial or mistaken setup leaves relay's checkout dirty with no allowed way back.
failing_case: Trial 2026-10-23: `relay setup <scratch>/tally --flow openspec --no-global` left ` M projects.toml` ([tally] entry) in /Users/amidman/relay; `git -C /Users/amidman/relay restore projects.toml` was refused by guard-main ("mutating git command in the main checkout"); bin/relay has no command that removes an entry.
pass_cases: After setup the relay checkout is clean (entry committed); one relay command removes the entry and leaves the checkout clean; the guard still refuses hand edits in the main checkout.
